summary.text: Charlene Ward Johnson is a Democratic state representative who has represented Texas House District 139 since January 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She previously served on the Houston Community College Board of Trustees.

paragraphs.text: Charlene Ward Johnson was born in Temple, Texas.

She earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Houston in 1992 and a graduate degree from the University of Arizona Global Campus in 2020, and her career experience includes working as a manager.

She has been affiliated with the Greater Houston Frontiers Club, Alpha Kappa Alpha Sorority, Top Ladies of Distinction, the Houston Livestock and Rodeo, the University of Houston Alumni Foundation and the A. Philip Randolph Institute.
Ward Johnson served on the Houston Community College Board of Trustees, District II, from 2023 to 2025.
She succeeded Jarvis Johnson in representing District 139 and assumed office on January 14, 2025.
She advanced from the March 3, 2026 Democratic primary; Kyle Harding is the Republican candidate in the 2026 general election.
